284177225.description:
Natural Rose Quartz
Rough Mineral Specimen
Natural Pink Quartz Crystal, Approximately 3.8 Inches
Natural rough rose quartz crystal specimen featuring soft pink coloration with translucent crystalline structure and characteristic conchoidal fracturing. Rose quartz is a classic variety of macrocrystalline quartz prized for its distinctive blush hue, caused by microscopic fibrous inclusions. Unpolished mineral specimens in raw form display natural cleavage planes, internal veining, and authentic geological texture, making them ideal for mineral collections, lapidary display, or decorative interior accents.
Authentic raw rose quartz mineral specimen with natural rough surfaces
Translucent pale to medium pink coloration with vitreous crystalline luster
Irregular geometric form showing natural fractures and internal crystalline planes
Measures approximately 3.8 inches long by 2.0 inches wide by 2.4 inches high
Condition:
Unpolished natural rough state with standard raw stone fractures, chips, and irregular cleavage inherent to natural mineral extraction. Minor surface dust and small adhesive residue spot present on one face as photographed. No artificial repairs or coatings observed.
